headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Telangana Today / Times of India / India Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: BRS hits back at Revanth over Sircilla remarks, questions Congress govt’s record on promises.
Amid SIR row, INDIA bloc puts up united front, targets PM Modi, Shah.
Trump says he raised political prisoners' cases with Chinese President Xi.
Mamata has backed Rahul as PM, Kharge seeks Opposition unity.
bullets_ur: BRS ne Sircilla ke bayan par Revanth ko jawab diya, Congress hukumat ke wade poore karne ke record par sawal uthaya.
SIR ke mamle ke bawajood, INDIA bloc ne yakjehti ka muzahira kiya, PM Modi aur Shah ko nishana banaya.
Trump ne kaha ke unhon ne Chinese President Xi se siyasi qaidiyon ke muamlaat uthaye.
Mamata ne Rahul ko PM ke liye support kiya, Kharge ne Opposition unity ka mutalba kiya.
